nodes.title: A nontrivial character obstructs generation

nodes.title: An additive birational cocycle descends through pseudo-regularization
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (𝕜 : Type) [Field 𝕜] (ι : Type 1) (c : ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 X] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Y], AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap X Y → (ι →₀ ℤ)), (∀ {X Y Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 X] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Y] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Z] (f : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap X Y) (h : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap Y Z), f.IsOver (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of 𝕜)) → h.IsOver (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of 𝕜)) → c (f.trans h) = c f + c h) → (∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 X] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Y] (i : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.PartialIso X Y), i.IsPseudoIso → c i.toBirationalMap = 0) → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ μ : MotivicInvariants.Cr 𝕜 n →* Multiplicative (ι →₀ ℤ), (∀ f : MotivicInvariants.Cr 𝕜 n, μ f = Multiplicative.ofAdd (c f.1)) ∧ (∀ f : MotivicInvariants.Cr 𝕜 n, f.1.IsPseudoRegularizable 𝕜 → μ f = 1)

nodes.title: A nonzero birational cocycle over a number field

nodes.title: An additive birational cocycle defines a Cremona homomorphism
nodes.lean_statement: ∀ (𝕜 : Type) [Field 𝕜] (ι : Type 1) (c : ∀ {X Y : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 X] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Y], AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap X Y → (ι →₀ ℤ)), (∀ {X Y Z : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme} [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 X] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Y] [MotivicInvariants.Variety 𝕜 Z] (f : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap X Y) (h : AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.BirationalMap Y Z), f.IsOver (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of 𝕜)) → h.IsOver (AlgebraicGeometry.Spec (CommRingCat.of 𝕜)) → c (f.trans h) = c f + c h) → ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ μ : MotivicInvariants.Cr 𝕜 n →* Multiplicative (ι →₀ ℤ), ∀ f : MotivicInvariants.Cr 𝕜 n, μ f = Multiplicative.ofAdd (c f.1)
